d3485.Raw_Article: 3485 Ta. toṭṭi fence, yard, pound, enclosure for selling timber or firewood, small village. Ma. toṭṭi long narrow garden, loft in a house; doṭṭi cattle-pound. ? To. twïḏy pair-word with twï·ṭm (see 3549). Ka. toṭṭi building with a square open court at the centre, the court itself; doḍḍi, daḍḍi cow-pen, cattle-pound, fold, stable. Koḍ. toḍia small garden adjoining a house. Tu. (DCV) duḍḍi cattle-pound. Te. doḍḍi backyard, stable for cattle. Go. (F-H.) ḍoḍi , (Grigson) ḍoḍī cow-pen ( Voc. 1609). Konḍa ḍoḍi backyard of house (for plants, etc. to grow). Kuwi (Isr.) ḍoḍi backyard of house, used for kitchen garden. Cf. 3526 Ta. tor̤u . DED(S, N) 2869.
